vacancy.title: Senior Frontend Developer
vacancy.description: We are looking for a Senior Frontend Developer to build B2B tools. Professional experience with React and TypeScript, accessible interfaces and automated testing is essential. Experience with design systems and collaboration with product teams is preferred. The team works remotely. We would like concrete project examples and an explanation of the person’s contribution.

candidates.name: Alex Rivera
candidates.text: FICTIONAL PROFILE FOR DEMONSTRATION Alex Rivera Frontend Developer Experience: 2021–2026 at Product One. Built B2B applications with React and TypeScript. Led the creation of a design system with 35 components. Added automated tests with Playwright and Vitest. Collaborated weekly with design and product teams. In 2025, improved accessibility with keyboard navigation and WCAG audits. A demonstration portfolio is available during the interview.

candidates.name: Sam Torres
candidates.text: FICTIONAL PROFILE FOR DEMONSTRATION Sam Torres Full Stack Developer Experience: 2022–2026 at Services Two. Developed APIs with Python, FastAPI and PostgreSQL. Built internal dashboards with React and JavaScript. Backend testing with pytest. Collaborated with product teams on delivery planning. Automated deployments with Docker. Interested in learning TypeScript and developing web accessibility skills.
